title: Payroll Tool Contracts
description: Tool schemas for the payroll domain. The Action Service validates model arguments against these schemas before passing to prepare.

investigate_payroll_anomaly.description: Investigate a potential payroll anomaly for a specific employee. Reads employee record, payroll record, and associated evidence. Does not modify any data.

period.description: ISO 8601 year-month (e.g. 2026-09). Defaults to current period.

anomaly_type.description: Focus the investigation on a specific anomaly type.

prepare_classification_correction.description: Prepare a reviewable proposal to correct an employee classification. High risk — requires human approval before any change is committed.

correction_type.description: The type of classification correction being proposed.

evidence_ids.description: IDs of evidence records that support this correction. At least one is required.

notes.description: Optional agent notes for the human reviewer. Not included in the proposal content sent to the provider.

flag_for_legal_review.description: Flag an employee record for legal team review without committing any change. Medium risk — requires approval to confirm that the flag is warranted.
